name: SetForwardObject
source: lane QT: 0x9330ab jumps to 0x933fb1, which stores the argument at +0x04 (the object slots 10, 21 and 46 forward to, src/gz/cGZWin.h) and returns whether it is non-null

name: FindChildAt
source: lane QT: 0x9319f9 walks the child list and returns the first child whose slot 93 accepts (x, y), else null

name: RouteMouseMessage
source: lane QT: 0x932462 reads the message's id and coordinates (words 0..2) and hands the message to the first visible, enabled child containing the point (its slot 96), else handles it itself

name: SetActiveChain
source: lane QT: 0x932231 tests the argument's low byte and, when set, walks the parents (slot 11); Activate (slot 4) calls it with 1

name: ContainsPoint
source: lane QT: 0x931a9c compares x and y (unsigned) with the width and height, then asks the children

name: CallMessageHooks
source: lane QT: 0x930cba passes (this, message) to each hook in the list at +0xa0 (their slot 3) until one answers true

name: HandleMessage
source: lane QT: 0x930a99 switches on the message's word 0 and calls the handler slots (159 mouse move, 161, ...) with its words
